other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Passing mention that power plants / energy generation companies must be energy managed under the standard
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Considering the fact, that more and 
more electricity is needed, power plants must 
be energy managed too, following sustainable 
lean and green principles, including the 
avoidance of toxic waste

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Mention of coal-burning power plants as industrial polluters (energy generation context)
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
coal-burning plants are some of the worst 
industrial polluters in the United States

one_line: Conceptual paper presenting ISO 50001:2011 energy management process models applicable to all organization types (manufacturing, transportation, services, etc.), with only passing mentions of power plants; no application, validation, or demonstration in any continuous-flow production sector.
